description:
List the account's published media, newest first.

Returns one page with a cursor. Covers feed posts, reels and carousels; stories are separate (instagram_list_stories) because they expire.

Use this to find media IDs for instagram_get_media_insights, instagram_list_comments, or instagram_get_media.

Example: "what did we post recently" -> limit=10

account_id.description: Instagram professional account ID. Omit to use the token's own account.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: Specific fields to request. Omit for a sensible default set: id, caption, media_type, media_product_type, media_url, permalink, thumbnail_url, timestamp, …

limit.description: Maximum items to return in this page. Default 25, max 100.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

name: instagram_list_media
title: List Media
